## One-Handed Melee
One-handed melee weapons are fast, easy to wield, and leave your other hand free for a shield, tool, or secondary weapon. They are ideal for close-quarters combat and self-defense.
## Knives
The most basic of survival tools - useful for crafting, hunting, and fighting.
[bold]Combat Knife[/bold]
Notes: Military-grade knife. Balanced for combat.
[bold]Kitchen Knife[/bold]
Notes: Common utility blade. Found in settlements.
[bold]Tribal Knife[/bold]
Notes: Handcrafted. Slightly shorter but reliable.
[bold]Butcher's Cleaver[/bold]
Notes: Heavy cutting blade. Good damage for a one-handed weapon.
## Hatchets & Axes
Fast and reliable. A staple tool and weapon throughout the Wasteland.
[bold]Hatchet[/bold]
Notes: Standard cutting axe. Common tool and weapon.
[bold]Tribal Hatchet[/bold]
Notes: Handcrafted variant. Slightly rougher than a manufactured hatchet.
[bold]Fire Axe[/bold]
Notes: Large head, heavy swing. Deals significant damage.
## Batons & Clubs
Non-lethal options for subduing enemies, or improvised weapons when nothing else is available.
[bold]Police Baton[/bold]
Notes: Pre-war law enforcement baton. Good for non-lethal takedowns.
[bold]Tribal Club[/bold]
Notes: Simple blunt weapon. Easy to find or make.
[bold]Broken Pipe[/bold]
Notes: Improvised weapon. Scavenged from ruins.
## Short Blades & Swords
One-handed blades that deal more damage than knives while remaining swift.
[bold]Machete[/bold]
Notes: Heavy cutting blade. Good against lightly armored targets.
[bold]Scrap Machete[/bold]
Notes: Post-war constructed machete. Functional but rougher.
[bold]Chinese Sword[/bold]
Notes: Pre-war officer's blade. Well-balanced and durable.
